sources: [S1] HZN (Croatian Standards Institute) — HRN EN ISO 22400, HRN EN 13306 (EU/CEN member since 2013)
[S3] MNG Centar Croatia — 'Sveukupna efektivnost opreme (OEE)' training
[S5] terms.json — Croatian translations analyzed for consistency

falseFriends.fabric: Use 'tkanina', not 'tvornica' (which means 'factory' — Croatian uses 'tvornica', not Serbian 'fabrika')

grammarNotes.latinScript: Latin script exclusively. Diacritics (č, ć, š, ž, đ) mandatory.
grammarNotes.ijekavianDialect: Croatian uses Ijekavian: 'vrijeme' (time), 'smjena' (shift) — not Serbian Ekavian 'vreme', 'smena'.
grammarNotes.compoundPluralModifiers: In compound noun phrases with genitive modifiers, prefer SINGULAR genitive for the modifier when it names a concept/category. PREFERRED: 'razlozi gubitka brzine' (reasons + loss [gen.sg] + speed [gen.sg]). CHECK: 'razlozi gubitaka brzine' — genitive plural 'gubitaka' may be governed by Croatian grammar. Flag for G3 native speaker review. Compare singular 'razlog gubitka brzine' — the modifier should ideally not change when only the head noun pluralizes.

industryContext.oeeTerminology: OEE (English acronym) is standard. Full: 'Sveukupna efektivnost opreme'.
industryContext.euMember: EU member since 2013 — all CEN/ISO standards mandatory.

commonMistakes: Using Serbian vocabulary: fabrika->tvornica, kvalitet->kvaliteta, smena->smjena
Dropping diacritics (č, ć, š, ž, đ)
Using Ekavian forms: 'vreme' instead of Ijekavian 'vrijeme'

Compound plural modifier ambiguity: 'razlozi gubitaka brzine' vs 'razlozi gubitka brzine' — genitive plural 'gubitaka' vs singular 'gubitka'. Prefer singular modifier (names the concept); flag for G3 native speaker review
notes: OEE (English) standard. Latin script. Formal 'Vi'. Ijekavian dialect required. 7-case system. EU member since 2013.
